बॉलीवुड के मशहूर सिंगर अभिजीत भट्टाचार्य ने लाइव परफॉरमेंस को लेकर छेड़ दी है एक नई बहस! 🎤

छत्तीसगढ़ राज्योत्सव 2026 में परफॉर्म करते हुए अभिजीत ने साफ कहा कि वह मंच पर कभी भी सिर्फ होंठ नहीं हिलाएंगे। उन्होंने उत्तराखंड के उस विवाद का जिक्र किया जहां मंत्री सुबोध उनियाल ने एक सिंगर को लाइव न गाने पर सबके सामने टोका था। अभिजीत का कहना है कि चाहे गला खराब हो या वह थक जाएं, लेकिन दर्शकों के पैसे और समय की इज्जत करते हुए वह हमेशा लाइव ही गाएंगे। 

बता दें कि पिछले महीने उत्तराखंड में मंत्री ने दलेर मेहंदी को बीच परफॉरमेंस में रोककर कहा था कि आप ठीक से बोल नहीं पा रहे तो गाएंगे क्या? रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक दलेर को इस शो के लिए 35 लाख रुपए दिए गए थे। हालांकि मीका सिंह ने मंत्री के व्यवहार को गलत बताया और दावा किया कि दलेर पाजी उस वक्त बीमार थे। अभिजीत ने साफ कर दिया कि वह जनता के साथ कभी ऐसा धोखा नहीं करेंगे। 🔥

क्या आपको भी लगता है कि भारी भरकम फीस लेने वाले सिंगर्स को कॉन्सर्ट में सिर्फ लाइव ही गाना चाहिए? कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Abhijeet Bhattacharya says he will never lip-sync during live concert as he refers to Daler Mehndi controversy
ctx.summary: Speaking at Chhattisgarh Rajyotsava, Abhijeet Bhattacharya said he would never lip-sync, whatever the condition of his voice.
ctx.text:
Singer Abhijeet Bhattacharya has addressed the controversy surrounding Daler Mehndi . The singer, who recently performed at Chhattisgarh Rajyotsava 2026, spoke out against the practice of lip-syncing during live performances. Although he did not name Daler , he referred to the incident in which a singer was called out by a minister for not singing live at an event.
A video of Abhijeet addressing the controversy has been doing the rounds on social media. In the clip, he says in Hindi, which translates to, "If someone is not actually singing live into the microphone, then don't allow it. A few days ago, there was an incident where a minister came onto the stage and spoke the truth. He said, 'You are not singing. You can barely stand, and you are not really performing live.' He spoke the truth. But he ended up becoming the villain in the eyes of many people. Yet this is something that happens on stages everywhere."
He added, "I request all of you, especially here in Chhattisgarh, not to let this happen. No matter how I sing, whether I sing badly, whether my voice is strained, whether I get tired, or whether I sing off-key, whatever I do, I will sing live. That is the respect I owe you for giving me your time. You have spent your hard-earned money, invited me here, and made all these arrangements. Behind this event lies the hard work of the administration, the department and all of you. I bow to all of you and promise that I will never cheat you in this way. I will never simply move my lips in the name of singing. Some people do that, but I won't."
A post shared by 𝔸ℕ𝕌𝕂ℝ𝕀𝕋𝕀 𝕊ℍ𝔸ℝ𝕄𝔸 ✨ (@anukritii.sharma)
Daler Mehndi was interrupted mid-performance by Uttarakhand Cabinet Minister Subodh Uniyal at a cultural event in Uttarakhand last month. The minister reprimanded the singer on stage, questioning his performance and also said that he looked disoriented on stage. He said, "You can't even speak properly, how will you sing?" Later, while speaking to ANI, the minister also mentioned that Daler was paid ₹ 35 lakh to perform at the event.
Following the incident, Daler's brother and fellow singer Mika Singh, along with several other celebrities, criticised the minister for disrespecting the singer. Mika also said that Daler was unwell during the performance. However, the minister refused to apologise to Daler.
